caption: The drawing depicts a small figurine of a man standing on a rectangular base. The man is wearing a wide-brimmed yellow hat, a loose, cream-colored shirt with red trim and details around the collar and belt area, and yellow pants with red trim at the waist and cuffs. He has black shoes and a black beard and hair. His shirt is billowy and tucked into his pants, and his hands are on his hips. The figure’s facial expression is prominently shown, with defined eyebrows and downward-curved mouth. The background is plain and uncolored, drawing focus entirely to the figurine in the center of the composition.
title: Figure of a Sailor
